# We act for Lumen Ridge Software, Inc. (Provider). Corvane Logistics Group, Inc. (Customer) has returned a marked-up version of our Form MSA v4.2 with its chang…

## What warranty period does the counterparty's latest draft of the MSA provide?

Section 9.1's warranty period was changed from 90 to 180 days but the change is unmarked in Corvane's markup; it must be called out, reversed to 90 days (P-14) and escalated. [F1] [F3]

## What does the playbook require when the counterparty makes a change without marking it?

Reverse the warranty period to ninety (90) days and escalate the unmarked change to the deal lead. [F2] [F1]

## What is the disposition of C-01?

C-01 (Payment terms Net 30 -> Net 45): ACCEPT. Net 45 is within playbook fallback P-1. [F3]

## What is the disposition of C-02?

C-02 (Deletion of 1.5% monthly late-payment interest): COUNTER. Reinstate s.4.2 at a reduced 1.0% per month (P-2). [F4]

## What is the disposition of C-03?

C-03 (General liability cap 12 -> 36 months' fees): COUNTER. Offer a 24 months' fees cap (P-3); 36 months exceeds the walk-away. [F5]

## What is the disposition of C-04?

C-04 (Uncapped liability for Provider's breach of s.8 (Data Security)): COUNTER. Replace the uncapped carve-out with a separate super-cap of 3x the annual Fees (P-4). [F6]

## What is the disposition of C-05?

C-05 (New s.4.4 most-favored-customer pricing): REJECT. MFN pricing is a P-5 walk-away; strike s.4.4. [F7]

## What is the disposition of C-06?

C-06 (Customer termination for convenience at any time on 30 days' notice): COUNTER. Allow termination for convenience only after the first 12 months, on 90 days' notice, with an early termination fee of 50% of remaining Fees (P-6). [F8]

## What is the disposition of C-07?

C-07 (Governing law Delaware -> New York): ACCEPT. New York law is an acceptable alternative under P-7. [F9]

## What is the disposition of C-08?

C-08 (SLA service-credit cap 10% -> 25%): COUNTER. Counter at a 15% service-credit cap (P-8). [F10]

## What is the disposition of C-09?

C-09 (On-site audit at any time on 10 business days' notice): COUNTER. Keep SOC 2 + questionnaire; allow on-site audits once per 12 months on 30 days' notice only after a confirmed Security Incident (P-9). [F11]

## What is the disposition of C-10?

C-10 (Cyber insurance $2M -> $5M per claim): ACCEPT. $5,000,000 is within P-10. [F12]

## What is the disposition of C-11?

C-11 (Customer may assign to any third party without consent): REJECT. Unilateral free assignment is a P-11 walk-away; keep mutual s.13.1. [F13]

## What is the disposition of C-12?

C-12 (Non-renewal notice 60 -> 90 days): ACCEPT. Up to 90 days is acceptable under P-12. [F14] [F3]

## What is the disposition of C-14?

C-14 (Deletion of lost profits from the consequential-damages exclusion): REJECT. Removing lost profits from the exclusion is a P-13 walk-away; reinstate. [F15]
